title: Curdione inhibits ferroptosis in isoprenaline-induced myocardial infarction via regulating Keap1/Trx1/GPX4 signaling pathway.
authors: Wang, Huihui; Xie, Baoping; Shi, Shuotao; Zhang, Rong; Liang, Qi; Liu, Zhongqiu; Cheng, Yuanyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Curdione通过Keap1/Trx1/GPX4通路抑制心肌梗死铁死亡，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Myocardial infarction (MI) is a common disease with high morbidity and mortality. Curdione is a sesquiterpenoid from Radix Curcumae. The current study is aimed to investigate the protective effect and mechanism of curdione on ferroptosis in MI. Isoproterenol (ISO) was used to induce MI injury in mice and H9c2 cells. Curdione was orally given to mice once daily for 7 days. Echocardiography, biochemical kits, and western blotting were performed on the markers of cardiac ferroptosis. Curdione at 50 and 100 mg/kg significantly alleviated ISO-induced myocardial injury. Curdione and ferrostatin-1 significantly attenuated ISO-induced H9c2 cell injury. Curdione effectively suppressed cardiac ferroptosis, evidenced by decreasing malondialdehyde and iron contents, and increasing glutathione (GSH) level, GSH peroxidase 4 (GPX4), and ferritin heavy chain 1 expression. Importantly, drug affinity responsive target stability, molecular docking, and surface plasmon resonance technologies elucidated the direct target Keap1 of curdione. Curdione disrupted the interaction between Keap1 and thioredoxin1 (Trx1) but enhanced the Trx1/GPX4 complex. In addition, curdione-derived protection against ISO-induced myocardial ferroptosis was blocked after overexpression of Keap1, while enhanced after Keap1 silence in H9c2 cells. These findings demonstrate that curdione inhibited ferroptosis in ISO-induced MI via regulating Keap1/Trx1/GPX4 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 心肌梗死（MI）是一种具有高发病率和死亡率的常见疾病。莪术酮（Curdione）是从莪术（Radix Curcumae）中提取的一种倍半萜类化合物。本研究旨在探讨莪术酮对心肌梗死中铁死亡（ferroptosis）的保护作用及其机制。使用异丙肾上腺素（ISO）诱导小鼠和H9c2细胞的心肌梗死损伤。莪术酮以每日一次口服给药小鼠，持续7天。通过超声心动图、生化试剂盒和蛋白质印迹法检测心脏铁死亡标志物。莪术酮在50和100 mg/kg剂量下显著减轻了ISO诱导的心肌损伤。莪术酮和ferrostatin-1显著减轻了ISO诱导的H9c2细胞损伤。莪术酮有效抑制了心脏铁死亡，表现为降低丙二醛和铁含量，并增加谷胱甘肽（GSH）水平、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）和铁蛋白重链1的表达。重要的是，药物亲和响应靶标稳定性、分子对接（molecular docking）和表面等离子体共振技术阐明了莪术酮的直接靶点Keap1。莪术酮破坏了Keap1与硫氧还蛋白1（Trx1）之间的相互作用，但增强了Trx1/GPX4复合物。此外，在H9c2细胞中，Keap1过表达阻断了莪术酮对ISO诱导心肌铁死亡的保护作用，而Keap1沉默则增强了该保护作用。这些发现表明，莪术酮通过调节Keap1/Trx1/GPX4信号通路抑制了ISO诱导心肌梗死中的铁死亡。
